item.name: Generate and return a proposal PDF for the specified quote with optional comparison quotes.

request.name: Generate and return a proposal PDF for the specified quote with optional comparison quotes.

description.content:
Query Parameters:
- comparison_quote_ids: Comma-separated list of quote IDs to include as comparisons
- coverage_types: Coverage types to include in coverage review section.
  Supports multiple formats:
  * Multiple parameters: coverage_types=A&coverage_types=B&coverage_types=C
  * Comma-separated: coverage_types=A,B,C
  * Mixed: coverage_types=A,B&coverage_types=C
- include_quote_summary: If false, skips merging the carrier quote summary PDF
  (default: true)
- quote_summary_pages: Optional comma/range page selection for the quote summary
  PDF (1-based, e.g. "1-3, 5"). When omitted or empty, all pages are included.
  Ignored when include_quote_summary is false.
- include_payment_link: If false, omits payment links from the proposal PDF
  (default: true)
- include_coverage_analysis: If false, omits the Coverage Analysis pages
  (key limits, retentions, and related tables) from the proposal PDF
  (default: true)
- include_quote_comparison: If false, omits the quote comparison section
  from the proposal PDF (default: true)
- return_json: If true, returns the JSON payload used for PDF generation instead of the PDF

Always generates the PDF on-demand to ensure dynamic comparison data is current.

# 1Fort API

REST API for the 1Fort insurance platform. This document is the authoritative
map of the API surface; endpoints are grouped in the sidebar by **app** and
**version**, and large apps are split into per-resource sub-groups.

## Authentication

Almost every endpoint requires a **JWT access token**. Send it in the
`Authorization` header as either `Bearer <token>` or `JWT <token>`. Tokens may
also be presented as an HTTP-only cookie. Endpoints documented with no security
requirement are intentionally public (for example sign-in, OTP and storefront
endpoints).

## Multi-tenancy

Resources are scoped to a tenant. Nested routes carry the owning resource id in
the path (for example `/v2/broker/{business_pk}/applications`); a token is only
authorised for the businesses its user may access. Object-level permissions are
enforced per endpoint.

## Versioning

`v2` endpoints live under `/apis/v2/...` and are the current surface. `v1`
endpoints remain documented for compatibility. Endpoints marked **deprecated**
are scheduled for removal; prefer the documented replacement.
